# Log Reset v0.1.70 - Table of Contents

> Resets configured log files.

## Modules

- [Log.Reset](https://log-reset.hexdocs.pm/Log.Reset.md): Resets configured log files.

- [Log.Reset.Log](https://log-reset.hexdocs.pm/Log.Reset.Log.md)
- [Log.Reset.LogPaths](https://log-reset.hexdocs.pm/Log.Reset.LogPaths.md): A map of configured log paths and functions.

- [Log.Reset.LogPaths.Server](https://log-reset.hexdocs.pm/Log.Reset.LogPaths.Server.md): A server process that holds a map of configured log paths as its state.

- [Log.Reset.TopSup](https://log-reset.hexdocs.pm/Log.Reset.TopSup.md)
